variant.briefing:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to [Location], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [Destination].

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
